reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified as genuine vulnerability. Source: 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, invariant 'Column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs arrays must all have equal length' (lines 244-261). Code verification: Gossip path calls verify_data_column_sidecar (gossip_validation.nim:596) which enforces length equality (peerdas_helpers.nim:362-364). Sync path (request_manager.nim:176-194) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof (line 190), skipping length validation before quarantine insertion (line 437). Block processor (block_processor.nim:687) then calls verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs which passes mismatched arrays to verifyCellKzgProofBatch (C-KZG library), causing undefined behavior. Attack path: An attacker can trigger this via P2P sync protocol (data_column_sidecars_by_root) by sending a DataColumnSidecar with mismatched array lengths (e.g., column.len=6, kzg_proofs.len=4), causing crash or memory corruption when the C-KZG library processes the mismatched arrays. Severity: Single-client bug affecting Nimbus only. Original severity HIGH downgraded to Medium based on deployment share threshold (>5% but <33% network impact for single-client DoS). If Nimbus share is <5%, actual severity is Low.
